rejected_rule.statement: In a rei vindicatio action, once the paper title is proved by the plaintiff, the burden shifts to the defendant to prove on what basis he is in possession of the land.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: It is well settled law that in a rei vindicatio action such as this, once the paper title is proved by the plaintiff, the burden shifts to the defendant to prove on what basis he is in possession of the land.
